pages.text: Copper and tuff halls buried deep underground. They're full of $(item)Trial Spawners$(), which wake when you come close and send a wave of mobs. The more players there are, the bigger the wave. Beat it and each player gets a reward, often a $(item)Trial Key$().

A $(item)Vault$() opens once per player for a $(item)Trial Key$(), and hands out its treasure. Ominous Vaults need an $(item)Ominous Trial Key$() and hold the best loot, including the $(item)Heavy Core$().

Drink an $(item)Ominous Bottle$() and come near a Trial Spawner: your Bad Omen becomes $(thing)Trial Omen$(), and the spawners turn ominous. You get tougher waves, items raining down on you, and Ominous Trial Keys as rewards.
The $(thing)Breeze$() lives here. It leaps about, throws $(item)Wind Charges$() and knocks your arrows aside. It drops $(item)Breeze Rods$().
